run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute maximum sum from a 2xN grid with no two adjacent elements selected
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple 2xN grid inputs to verify correct maximum sum calculation
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to support grids with more than two rows
